scope: H0/H1 native shared-CU, Sv32 and coherent staging correctness, plus accepted-response texture fault ownership. No production host/VM ABI or performance qualification.

functional.target_profile_replay: The one-test replay validates the later heap guard; it is a repeat of one of the eleven distinct checks, not a twelfth check.
functional.target_profile_heap_requirement: At least 4 GiB maximum JVM heap; the test reports insufficient heap explicitly. Qualification runs use -J-Xmx8G and all four configurations execute.

harness.execution: RenderCore uses the actual GpuSystem CU pool and shared shader task router; no private graphics CUs. FPU enabled, L2 eight sets/two ways, CU caches four sets/one way.
harness.memory: Real TranslatedLineClient for staging and three unbuffered TranslatedWordClient instances for command, attachment and texture. Disjoint data/walk IDs are restored on response; a unique-owner assertion covers graphics response IDs.
harness.lower_service: Deterministic request stalls; seeded response delays 4..20 cycles and younger-ready responses first. Write bytes publish only on acknowledgement; a held response keeps frozen data. Live system transaction IDs cannot alias.
harness.vm: Sv32 roots, ASIDs and physical superpages change only after all graphics, compute and lower-memory traffic drains. Same virtual bindings map to new physical backing. Lower requests must lie in the current physical context or reserved page-table range. SATP/flush ownership is external to this validation harness.
harness.workload: 8x8 resident tile, 1x RGBA8+D24S8. Two overlapping draws: LESS retains the first; the final healthy pass uses ALWAYS so changed second-draw inputs must reach stored samples. Illegal shader and invalid command mapping precede healthy reuse.
harness.compute: Submit host compute ID 1 once graphics has CU ownership; it overlaps graphics on a separate CU, completes with unchanged ID/success, and stores 0x123. Graphics router client 1 also uses ID 1 in its separate namespace.
harness.completion: Context/pass/generation retained; all color/depth samples checked independently; failed-pass attachments retain sentinels. Hold graphics result five cycles with a new job blocked.

texture_failure.qualification: Fault sideband is applied only on accepted texture responses.
other_checks: Sideband high without accepted response does not fault healthy passes.
Shader failure during texture drain does not replace texture status.
Late cancel/command/shader/texture inputs do not alter a published result.
Precise attachment-owner memory faults retain their own status.

limitations: Small 8x8, single-sample workload with dispatch caps of eight/sixteen; not full resident-warp utilization or throughput.
Cycle counts include test control, stalls and faults and use different dispatch capacities; no scaling or frame-rate comparison follows.
No production RenderHost/unified AXI persistent submission or hardware VM context ownership yet.
Render-to-texture, DMA and CPU cache-domain publication/barriers remain to integrate and verify.
General descriptors, multiple tile engines, payload SRAM and all remaining H0-H8 capability/physical/product gates remain required.
Texture fault is tested through the fixed-function core response path; this record does not prove a textured shader Sv32-fault workload.
